items.description: Internal frost-burst fitting repair incl. thermal-imaging leak detection (flat rate)
items.rationale: Frost fracture of an internal fitting is covered under 2.4.4 and 7.1.9, and thermal-imaging leak location under 2.4.6 and 5.2.2 (cap EUR 2,500, not reached); the lump sum prices covered work only (7.1.12). Estimated at an ordinary market price of about EUR 300-400 for the fitting repair with one attendance plus about EUR 350-400 for the leak detection.

items.description: Exterior facade frost damage repair (re-plaster and repaint, flat rate)
items.rationale: The plaster failed from outdoor frost acting from without, which is the optional peril 2.1(d); nothing in the description shows it as agreed, so 2.6.4 and 3.5(a)-(c) exclude the whole combined line, and 2.4.3 does not apply because the water did not come from the internal escape. The figure is a market estimate for re-plastering and repainting the damaged area only in case the peril was in fact agreed.
